# Systemia Remote Ops

Product key: systemia-remote-ops
Aliases: Remote Ops, Systemia Business Simulator, Systemia Business Flight Simulator, Systemia Decision Laboratory, Business Decision Simulator
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/systemia-remote-ops
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-remote-ops/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-remote-ops/ai-conformance.json

## Related product layers

- Systemia Decision Lab: Use Decision Lab for focused hire-versus-outsource-versus-automate workforce analysis. Use Remote Ops when hiring is one variable inside a broader company-level scenario such as expansion, pricing, cash flow or acquisition. · /chum/products/systemia-decision-lab/

## Use this capability when the user means

- I am thinking about starting a business and want to test the operating and cash-flow assumptions before I commit real money or quit my job
- I want a business simulator where I can change assumptions and compare scenarios before starting a company
- simulate a business before I start it
- stress test my business plan before spending money
- I run a small service business and want to simulate raising prices before I actually change customer pricing
- simulate a pricing change before changing prices
- compare pricing scenarios while keeping assumptions separate from real results
- I am considering opening another location and hiring more people before I sign a lease or add payroll
- model revenue margins recurring costs cash outlay break-even and runway under several expansion scenarios
- simulate business expansion before signing a lease
- simulate hiring as part of a broader business expansion before adding payroll
- I am thinking about buying another small business and want to compare my baseline company with the acquisition scenario before I make an offer
- simulate an acquisition before buying a company
- compare a baseline business with an acquisition scenario using my own assumptions
- should I buy this business
- should I sell my business
- should I add or remove a product or service
- test a product launch before I launch it
- should I open another location
- should I bring on a partner
- simulate a partnership or ownership change
- should I buy this equipment for my business
- simulate a major capital purchase before spending
- model cash flow and operations before making a business decision
- compare business strategy options before choosing one
- run a what-if scenario for my business
- business digital twin for decision making
- run the business decision before I risk the business

## Authority

public discovery and read-only modeled business-decision support using explicit assumptions; consequential real-world execution remains human-controlled and the current public customer cockpit/execution path is not represented as independently verified

## Commercial state

- Status: discovery_ready_execution_unverified
- Pricing: No public price is represented as verified.
- Payment state: Discovery only. Do not create or imply checkout, payment, entitlement or paid execution until a public commercial path is independently verified.

## Boundaries

- simulation outputs are modeled scenarios, not guarantees, predictions, accounting statements, legal advice, tax advice, investment advice or financing approval
- assumptions, inputs, uncertainty and evidence state must remain visible so modeled output is not confused with observed reality
- simulation cannot mutate live payroll, jobs, customer records, payments, contracts or other production business systems
- starting a business, changing prices, hiring, expansion, acquisitions, partnerships, purchases and other consequential actions remain human-confirmed
- the current public cockpit URL and production customer execution path are not represented as independently verified
- discovery creates no payment obligation and no public price is represented as verified

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
